examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default highlight button at large size with an icon.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import HighlightButton from '@aziontech/webkit/highlight-button'
</script>

<template>
  <HighlightButton
    size="large"
    label="Ask Azion"
    icon="ai ai-sparkles"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: All size variants side by side.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: Loading adopts the disabled visual treatment for clarity: the gradient is replaced by disabled tokens, a spinner replaces the icon, and activation is blocked while the async action runs.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import HighlightButton from '@aziontech/webkit/highlight-button'
</script>

<template>
  <HighlightButton
    label="Ask Azion"
    icon="ai ai-sparkles"
    loading
  />
</template>
